summary: The Simpsons entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: The Simpsons: Hit & Run
entries.definitive_edition: Original Windows PC release with documented compatibility fixes

emulation.emulator: Dolphin / PCSX2 / xemu only for console-version comparison
emulation.notes: Use native PC for primary if owned; use console emulation only to compare original platform behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Owned PC copy with compatibility fixes, or original console hardware for exact console behavior

primary.version: Original PC release with compatibility fixes
primary.why: Hit & Run has no current official remaster or storefront route, and the Windows version is the most flexible capture target if an owned copy is available. GameCube/PS2/Xbox are important original-console routes but less convenient for high-resolution archival capture.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Windows PC copy with compatibility fixes or original console hardware if PC access is unavailable. Record platform, region, patch/fan-fix state, resolution, controller, and whether mods were disabled for vanilla capture.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original console presentation and controller behavior
secondary.what_to_play: Use if preserving exact console-era behavior matters.
secondary.why: The PC route is easier to capture, but console versions are the original living-room routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record any fan patches or mods and keep vanilla capture separate from modded runs.

entries.title: The Simpsons Game
entries.definitive_edition: PlayStation 3 or Xbox 360 HD console version, with DS version documented separately if desired

emulation.emulator: RPCS3/Xenia optional for HD route; melonDS for DS comparison
emulation.notes: Use original hardware if emulator compatibility/performance is not verified.

primary.why: The Simpsons Game was not released on PC. The PS3/Xbox 360 route is the high-fidelity HD version, while Wii/PS2/PSP and DS versions are separate lower-spec or handheld adaptations with platform-specific differences.
primary.how_to_play: Use PS3 or Xbox 360 hardware, or a documented emulator route. Record platform, patch, resolution/performance, controller, collectibles, co-op state, and whether DS or Wii/PS2/PSP variants were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Play separately if the archive wants handheld-version coverage.
secondary.why: The DS version is not equivalent to the HD console game.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC or modern remaster route. Record platform because versions differ.
